modules.objective: Provide low-latency microphone/speaker capture and virtual audio routing for calling applications.
boundaries: Native virtual-device distribution requires platform-specific signing, compatibility and release verification

Do not claim physical hotplug/default-device recovery, virtual microphone routing, calling-app compatibility or hardware latency/jitter until those platform-specific paths have direct verification evidence
completion_evidence: Rust native workspace and vsn-audio-core initialized

Platform-neutral device catalog implements preferred/default/active fallback and lifecycle state handling
DeviceSelectionController implements deterministic preferred/default/hotplug selection transitions
StreamController implements bounded invalidation recovery, exponential retry backoff and processing safe-bypass transitions

EnginePeriodRange and frames_for_duration validate fundamental/min/max/default period grids and select the nearest supported period for IAudioClient3 shared-mode planning

SharedCapturePlan separates WASAPI engine callback frames from pipeline sample framing and marks accumulator-required cadence explicitly
GitHub Actions run 34421431894 passed repository gates for SharedCapturePlan

update_notes: Windows event-driven WASAPI capture, packet reframing/assembly, bounded runtime recovery, structured lifecycle failure classification, MMDevice notification registration and deterministic notification-to-recovery bridging are now code-level and CI verified. Hosted Windows CI proves compile/Clippy/tests plus callback registration/unregistration, but it does not prove a physical unplug/default-device event fired on real audio hardware. Physical hotplug/default-device recovery, controlled hardware latency/jitter, the virtual microphone endpoint/driver, calling-app routing and driver release/signing evidence remain pending; MOD-002 therefore remains in progress.
